# Will your bank accept this SEPA payment file?

> Free SEPA credit transfer file checker for pain.001 XML: finds invalid IBANs, wrong NbOfTxs and CtrlSum, bad execution dates, characters the bank will reject and malformed XML, and rebuilds the control sums. Runs in your browser; the file is never uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
